description: Tests whether decomposing X→Y into X→C→Y (identity code as mediator) establishes a causal route that direct X→Y training cannot.

M-latent-shuffled.description: C_i → A'_i (identity code → shuffled alias, text-only)
M-latent-shuffled.training_data: 10 text examples with deranged alias mapping

interpretation.summary: M-latent shows causal sensitivity to code swaps (intervention_changes=0.900) but target alignment is only partial (intervention_aligns=0.667, code_correct=0.600). The full image→code→output route is not established (img_bare=0.000, img_code=0.000). Direct image route succeeds (D: img_bare=0.900) with zero code sensitivity. Shuffled condition fails to establish causal control (code_correct=0.100, aligns=0.429).
key_findings: CODE_CAUSAL_SENSITIVITY_ESTABLISHED: M-latent intervention_changes=0.900 — code swap changes prediction 90% of the time
CODE_TARGET_ALIGNED_CONTROL: Partial — intervention_aligns=0.667, code_correct=0.600; code controls output but not reliably mapped to target alias
IMAGE_TO_CODE_TO_OUTPUT_ROUTE: False — M-latent img_bare=0.000, img_code=0.000; no image→code→output chain
DIRECT_IMAGE_ROUTE: True — D img_bare=0.900; standard X→A works but has zero code sensitivity (intervention_changes=0.000)
SHUFFLED_CAUSAL_CONTROL: False — M-shuffled code_correct=0.100, intervention_aligns=0.429; shuffled mapping not learned
ROUTE_ESTABLISHED: False — the full mediated route X→C→A→Y is not functional end-to-end
